title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
snippet: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.

title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
snippet: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
